>
[Dragon Turtle Armor](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3160)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Season of Ghosts</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=721" />
<trait label="Abjuration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=2" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=637" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #199: To Bloom Below the Web](/Sources.aspx?ID=225) pg. 75

**Price** 2,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn armor

**Bulk** 4
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Armor** [Full Plate](/Armor.aspx?ID=13)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This _+1 resilient [full plate](/Armor.aspx?ID=50)_	 is crafted from the most colorful fragments chipped from scales of a dragon turtle's shell, traditionally incorporating that motif in the form of a thicker, sturdier backplate. While wearing this armor, you aren't [flat-footed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=16) from creatures that flank you, and you ignore the armor's speed penalty when you [Swim](/Actions.aspx?ID=2381) and its check penalty to Athletics checks to Swim.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
